text.p: The average yields at auctions of three-, six-, nine- and 12-month treasury bills slipped from the last sale on March 13, a central bank statement said on Monday.

Three-month bills slipped to 24.20 percent from 24.24 percent, six-month bills edged down to 29.99 percent from 30.15 percent, nine-month bills eased to 32.93 percent from 32.95 percent, and 12-month bills eased to 35.56 percent from 35.60 percent.
The results of Friday's three-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume 10.00 million UAH 8.00 million UAH
Amount sold 10.00 million UAH 8.00 million UAH
Actual amount raised 9.43 million UAH 7.54 million UAH
The central bank sold 100,000 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
The date of the next auction of three-month discount T-bills is scheduled for March 18.
The results of six-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume 12.00 million UAH 12.00 million UAH
Amount sold 12.00 million UAH 12.00 million UAH
Actual amount raised 10.44 million UAH 10.43 million UAH
The central bank sold 120,000 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
The date of the next auction of six-month discount T-bills is scheduled for March 18.
The results of nine-month discount T-bills auction, compared to last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume 31.00 million UAH 31.00 million UAH
Amount sold 31.00 million UAH 30.92 million UAH
Actual amount raised 24.87 million UAH 24.81 million UAH
The central bank sold 310,000 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
The date of the next auction of nine-month discount T-bills is scheduled for March 18.
The results of 12-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume 37.00 million UAH 37.00 million UAH
Amount sold 37.00 million UAH 37.00 million UAH
Actual amount raised 27.31 million UAH 27.31 million UAH
The central bank sold 370,000 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
The date of the next auction of 12-month discount T-bills is scheduled for March 18.
